clauses.source_paraphrase: The visible prompt requests eight separate beginner panda drawing-guide images; detailed step instructions are collapsed. The capture contains no compared prompt versions and does not report a prompt rewrite.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Image-generation systems should preserve traceability between the user’s request, any transformed instruction and the content on which a safety decision rests.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: An unseen transformation could be relevant to the request-to-output lineage, but the capture supplies neither a reported rewrite nor compared versions. A material lineage break remains unestablished.

clauses.source_paraphrase: A children’s panda drawing-guide request was followed by a message saying a created image might violate harassment, discrimination or bullying guardrails.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A refusal explanation should identify the actual affected stage and state only the content basis supported by the visible or reviewable material.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The displayed lesson request looks innocuous and the refusal names a serious category, but the system refers to an unseen generated image and the detailed image instructions are collapsed. The capture cannot test whether that category lacked a basis.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The adjacent post says the intended lesson was for the author’s daughter and complains of frequent refusals. Prior attempts, completed images and any successful retry are not displayed.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An author’s general complaint does not establish every prior attempt or a subsequent outcome.
